segments.title: 第67章 四人成行
segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 67: A Group of Four

September 1st, the first day of school at Fuyi High.

Shao Heqi woke up, washed up, and left for school with his backpack on.

He didn't go straight downstairs, but walked to the opposite door and knocked.

The one who opened the door was a student about his age, wearing the Fuyi High school uniform with the number "2013" on the back, indicating he was a second-year senior.

"Let's go," Shao Heqi's cousin, Shao Youpeng, said with a smile. "There's an opening exam this year, right? You'd better do well."

"Yeah." Shao Heqi nodded forcefully, his eyes filled with determination.

The two cousins went downstairs and had breakfast at a shop near the entrance of their residential complex.

Led by Shao Heqi's father, their two families had each bought an apartment in the complex next to Fuyi High.

However, concerned that the two boys couldn't manage themselves, they still boarded at the school despite owning the apartments.

Shao Heqi would only come back here to stay on weekends, or on school holidays like yesterday.

While eating breakfast, the two started to chat.

"You've just arrived at Fuyi High, so there's a lot you don't know. You can ask me anything," Shao Youpeng said, eating his pan-fried dumplings. "I'm usually in Class 1 of Year Two, on the fourth floor of the teaching building behind yours. Just come find me if you need anything."

"Got it, Bro." Shao Heqi nodded, though he was still a little down. "You're so much better than me, I couldn't even get into Class 1."

"Are you sad because you couldn't get into Class 1?" Shao Youpeng glanced at him, knowing his cousin's character all too well. "Or are you thinking about that girl named Ying Chanxi?"

"Bro, keep your voice down." Shao Heqi looked around, a little embarrassed. "You've never seen Ying Chanxi. If you had, you'd definitely like her too."

"I think you just haven't seen enough of the world." Shao Youpeng shook his head repeatedly. "Do you know Xu Youyu? She used to go to your Yucai Middle School too. Have you ever seen her?"

"I think I've heard the name," Shao Heqi recalled, "but I don't think I've ever seen her."

"See? That's why I said you haven't seen enough of the world." Shao Youpeng chuckled twice. "Xu Youyu is the class president of Year Two, Class 1, the vice president of the Literature Club, and the vice president of the Student Council. Now that she's in her second year, she'll probably become the full president soon."

"Plus, she was first in the year for all of Year One and basically never dropped from that spot in any major exam."

"She herself is very beautiful, and..."

Shao Youpeng said in a low voice, "her figure is amazing."

Shao Heqi was stunned by his words, then said, unconvinced, "Ying Chanxi is not bad either. She's also first in the year and the class president. Maybe she'll join the Student Council in the future too."

"Tch, just you wait." Shao Youpeng waved his hand dismissively. "Come find me at lunchtime, and I'll take you to see what Xu Youyu looks like. Then you'll know."

"Then I'll take you to see Ying Chanxi," Shao Heqi retorted, a competitive spirit stirring within him. He even added, "And there's another girl in our class who sings incredibly well, and she's no less beautiful than Ying Chanxi."

"Hmm?" Shao Youpeng looked at him in surprise. "Your affections are straying already?"

"I-I was just saying! She's really pretty."

Just as the two cousins were chatting while eating breakfast, three more customers arrived at the shop's entrance.

"Boss, ten pan-fried dumplings, two fried buns, a bowl of wontons, a basket of xiaolongbao, one bowl of sweet tofu pudding, and one bowl of savory tofu pudding."

Li Luo's voice sounded in the breakfast shop. "Senior, what are you having?"

"I'll just have the minced pork noodles, and a pack of soy milk," Xu Youyu said.

"Let me pay," Ying Chanxi's voice followed. "Boss, how much is it? I'll pay for it all."

Hearing the familiar voices, Shao Heqi and Shao Youpeng subconsciously stopped their chopsticks and looked toward the entrance of the breakfast shop.

The next second, both of them lit up, exchanged a glance, and then said impatiently—

"Look, that's Ying Chanxi!"

"Look, that's Xu Youyu!"

As soon as they spoke, the two cousins stared at each other, stunned on the spot. Then they whipped their heads back to look over there again.

By this time, Ying Chanxi had already paid and was walking into the shop with Xu Youyu to find a table, while Li Luo was responsible for waiting for their orders.

Watching the two fairy-like girls walk into the shop, Shao Heqi and Shao Youpeng almost held their breath.

Shao Heqi's gaze fell on Xu Youyu's chest, and he suddenly understood the specific meaning behind his cousin's earlier comment about her "amazing figure."

Meanwhile, Shao Youpeng was looking at Ying Chanxi. He was instantly captivated by her pure and sweet face, momentarily lost for words.

"Bro, Xu Youyu really is very pretty."

"Qi, Ying Chanxi isn't bad either. I think I'm starting to understand you."

As they were talking, Li Luo had already carried the tray to a table and sat down beside Ying Chanxi.

It was only then that Shao Youpeng noticed the obtrusive boy beside them and couldn't help asking, "Who's that guy? Why is he sitting with the two of them?"

"That..." Shao Heqi looked somewhat awkward and helpless. "He's Ying Chanxi's next-door neighbor, and now he's the class president of our Class 8."

"Are they close?" Shao Youpeng raised his eyebrows.

"I guess so..."

"Looks like you still have a long way to go," Shao Youpeng said, patting his cousin's shoulder.

But the next second, he saw Xu Youyu suddenly extend her chopsticks and cheerfully pluck a pan-fried dumpling from Li Luo's plate.

"These noodles aren't as good as your fried noodles."

"We ran out of noodles at home, otherwise we wouldn't have come here for breakfast."

"Bro," Shao Heqi said, looking at Shao Youpeng with a somber gaze, "it seems like your situation isn't much better."

...

To be honest, this was the first time in Li Luo's two lifetimes that he had seen Xu Youyu in a school uniform.

Xu Youyu had a great figure, and even the loose blue and white school uniform couldn't hide her graceful curves.

At home, Xu Youyu usually wore fresh and trendy clothes, which made her look much more mature.

Now, having changed into a school uniform, she had an added touch of purity.

After finishing breakfast, the three of them walked toward the school gate together.

Just as Yan Zhusheng arrived at the school gate, she spotted Li Luo from a distance and walked straight over to him, saying, "I've got an idea for the arrangement. You can come straight to my house on Saturday."

"Is it the song Li Luo wrote?" Ying Chanxi asked curiously, leaning over from behind Li Luo to look at Yan Zhusheng.

"Yes," Yan Zhusheng nodded. "But he only gave me the basic melody and lyrics, so it needs to be rearranged and recorded."

"I see." Ying Chanxi blinked and asked again, "Can I come along on Saturday? I've never seen a song being recorded live."

"Sure," Yan Zhusheng agreed without a second thought.

"What about me, what about me!" Xu Youyu couldn't help but ask. "I've never seen a live recording either."

Xu Youyu herself was an author of entertainment industry novels, so she naturally didn't want to miss an opportunity to gain some insight.

But Yan Zhusheng looked at her in confusion, then at Li Luo, and asked, "Who is she?"

"A second-year senior. I guess she's a friend of mine and Ying Chanxi's."

"Oh," Yan Zhusheng nodded and said, "If she's a friend of yours, then she can come."

With the weekend's itinerary settled, the group of four walked through the school gate.

Along the way, they attracted the gazes of countless students.
